crossRefs.note: Wait for Yahweh, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall…
The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,
so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges…
My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.
Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes;
for Yahweh will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.
Your eyes will see, and you will say, “Yahweh is great—even beyond the border of Israel!”
Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them; for the deeds of his hands will be paid back to him.
For if the word spoken through angels proved steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just…

translations.web: You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.
translations.bsb: You will only see it with your eyes and witness the punishment of the wicked.
translations.kjv: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.
translations.asv: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold, And see the reward of the wicked.
